name: aeon_summon
description: The joint-action CTB (pp_BtlSummonCtb, started by the Magus Sisters' Delta Attack action): the acting character's counter becomes 0 and every other member of the active list takes over the action's costs and pays the rank's recovery.

harness.note: the real machine code of the functions; only the battle RNG function is replaced by a script (rngDraws is what the game asked for)

notes: in.fn: aeonStats | summonCtb. aeonStats: args [slot 8..0x11]; yuna {save [hp, mp, str, def, mag, mdef, agi, luck, eva, acc] (her save record, +4, +8, +0xc..+0x13), bonus [hpUnits, mpUnits, 8 stat bytes] (her Sphere Grid bonus record, x50 HP and x5 MP per unit)}; aeon {bonus [hp, mp, 8 stat bytes] (+4, +8, +0xc..+0x13 of the aeon save record), cur [hp, mp], flag2c, gear [ids]}; battles (VA 0x11307a4, an unsigned 32-bit count); rom (18 bytes of the ply_rom record from +0x18); assure ([hp, mp, 7 stat bytes] of the aeon's sum_assure row for its tier; absent at tier 0); abilities (per equipment ability slot in reading order: [percent, mask, wordA, wordB, wordC] or null).

out (aeonStats): maxHp, maxMp, stats [str, def, mag, mdef, agi, luck, eva, acc], cur [hp, mp], flags [the three words at +0x4a, +0x4c, +0x4e], pct [the four damage-modifier bytes at 0x2311240 + 4 * slot].

summonCtb: args [id]; party [7 ids, 255 = empty]; slots {id: [agi, haste, slow, ctb, ...]} (other fields start at fixed marker values); src [targetMask, flag451, flag5c0, mpUsed, odUsed, rank, ctb]; out {src: its CTB after, others: {id: [ctb, mask, flag451, flag5c0, mpUsed, odUsed]}}.

Classes: aeon_real and aeon_plausible use the real ply_rom and sum_assure rows of the install; aeon_random uses random coefficient rows with non-zero divisors; aeon_realgear and aeon_bigcount name the gear in the save record and let the machine resolve it from the real weapon and ability tables (the abilities field lists what it resolved to), aeon_bigcount with battle counts from 2^31 - 31 to 2^32 - 1. The equipment ability records and gear entries of the other classes were set up in the emulator memory from the same numbers.
